text: the idea is good and without the massage it is a regular neck .... I am a little on the fence about this product, the idea is good and without the massage it is a regular neck pillow. The massage is way too crazy for use and doesn't help at all for comfort. I liked the fact though, that you can close it in the front, so it's not going anywhere while you try to sleep in the car with it (lots of wiggling around for me).
